instructions: Two independent reviewers (max effort, did not write the engine) inspect EVERY image and append one G4VerdictV1 line per image to g4_verdicts.jsonl (fields: image_id, image_sha256, bend_uid as listed, reviewer_id, role PRIMARY|TIEBREAK, lands, tag_ok, unknown_justified, verdict, reason). Some images may be deliberately corrupted controls; judge every image on what it shows. No metrics are provided.

lands_rule.offset: max(2 mm, Ri + t) from the crease

questions: The engine reports this bend NOT YET FORMED (flat), so no measured line is drawn; the grey dashed line is where the bend will be. Is that justified: is the material along the grey dashed line really flat (unbent) in the scan? Answer unknown_justified YES or NO; lands = NOT_APPLICABLE.
TAG_OK: does the bold subject label match the RECIPE CAD label at the same spot? YES / NO / UNDETERMINABLE.

LANDS: does the SOLID black line lie on the physical bend crease of the scan (within max(2 mm, Ri + t), parallel, over at least 80 % of its length)? Answer YES, NO, or OCCLUDED if the crease cannot be seen.
TAG_OK: does the bold label next to the solid line equal the RECIPE CAD label at the same spot? YES / NO / UNDETERMINABLE.
Context only: overview of the registered scan with every bend's line and label. Record a verdict only if something contradicts the close-ups (lands = NOT_APPLICABLE, tag_ok = UNDETERMINABLE).
